suite: Are We Fast Yet (Marr, Daloze, Mössenböck, DLS 2016)

sysl.command: (cd benchmarks/sysl && SYSL_NO_CACHE=1 sysl build --release -O3 --cpu native --lto full --cc /usr/bin/clang -o <build>/harness-sysl .)

rust.command: (cd benchmarks/Rust && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-cpu=native' cargo build --release --locked && cp target/release/harness <build>/harness-rust)
